description: Chat-engine replacement: the same turns under every installed harness, graded by effect (what exists afterwards) plus proof that the harness answered. A swapped mouth's hands are the plane's executed tools plus the native mouth's own tools reached through the mouth bridge (chat-thread management, create_task, switch_personality and the other chat-runtime tools; plane/chat_turn.rs NOT_A_PLANE_EXECUTED_HAND names the ones the plane never runs itself), so effects here may use any of them: task reads and updates, the agent roster, memory, and the probes the mouth creates itself (a task, a chat thread). Existence effects (task_exists, thread_exists) name the title the rig looks for and the rig deletes what it finds. Three per-case options shape a memory oracle: delete_task_after_turn N removes the setup task once turn N has answered (a refused delete or a task still readable afterwards is a failed precondition), no_tools_turn N fails the case if turn N used any tool, and turn_answer_must_not_contain fails the case if the named turn's answer carried the withheld value, so a recall cannot be a replay of an earlier answer. stream: true sends the turns over the SSE route; min_token_events N fails the case when a streamed turn carried fewer token frames, and engines_exempt lists the engines for which that shortfall is documented (partial, not fail).
